name: ehis-next
description: Independent EHIS capstone starter for a four-person team

scripts.test:integration: npm run functions:build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:exec --project demo-ehis-next --only auth,firestore,functions "node scripts/smoke-starter.cjs"
scripts.emulators: npm run functions:build && npx -y firebase-tools@latest emulators:start --project demo-ehis-next
scripts.check: npm --prefix mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run lint && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix functions test
